bom.alert_status: Strong El Niño continues to intensify amid record-warm global sea-surface temperatures
bom.summary: El Niño is firmly established. Both oceanic and atmospheric indices now reflect values consistent with a strong El Niño, with further intensification likely during spring.

ecmwf.summary: 51-member SEAS5 ensemble for 2027-02: median Niño 3.4 anomaly +4.06 deg C; 51/51 members above +1.5 (~100% above +2.0, ~100% above +2.5).

physical_state.wwb_domain: 10N-10S, 130E-150W; 5x10 deg sliding window; thresholds 5 m/s base + 7 m/s peak, >=5 days persistence, 10-day peak-to-peak recovery (v1.7)
